# AngelScript

Unmodified copy of [AngelScript](https://github.com/anjo76/angelscript) **2.39.0**
(tag `v2.39.0`, commit `4857f0b48a3122967478417c1270ecef1f4fe590`), the library and all its add-ons. Only the add-ons listed in `cmake/AngelScript.cmake` are compiled; add one there to use it.

Never edit files under `sdk/`. Local changes go in `patches/` as patch files, with a note saying why,
so the next update is: replace `sdk/`, re-apply `patches/`.
